long_biography.plain_text:
At Dwyer, property developer Joseph 'Joey' Esfandi combined asset sales with cuts in borrowing and overheads before pursuing fresh acquisitions. Working with Peter Andrews, the group's property director, he sought a balance between reliable rental income and opportunities to trade or redevelop buildings. Rental income covered interest and overheads as the company prepared another round of purchases.

Esfandi also serves as a trustee of the Esfandi Charitable Foundation, a grant-making trust established in 2004. Its trustees distribute donations to organisations working in education, healthcare and community welfare. Grants have included funding for Jewish Care, alongside schools, medical charities and organisations providing practical assistance.
